messages.subject: multiple conditional panels don't work
parts:
I'm trying to use multiple conditional panels but they don't work. The first conditional panel is shown only when the condition is fulfilled, but the rest of panel are always shown.
my code:

             selectInput("plot", 
                "To plot:",
                 c("A" = "a",
                       "B" = "b")),
   
   br(),
   conditionalPanel(condition = "input.plot == 'a'",
sliderInput("c", 
                "C:", 
                min = 1,
                max = 10, 
                value = 5),
br(),
checkboxInput("d", "D",TRUE)),
conditionalPanel(condition = "input.d == TRUE",
sliderInput("cl", "Change cl",
min = 0, max = 5, value = 0)),

conditionalPanel(condition = "input.plot == 'b'",
br(),
    checkboxInput("e", "E", FALSE),
    helpText("Note: Not choosing minimum one of the options, will show you only the raw data!")) )



where do you think that the problem is?

Thank you!

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: multiple conditional panels don't work
parts:
TRUE is not a logical constant in JavaScript. JavaScript is not R. In
JavaScript, it is true. The condition "input.d == TRUE" should be
"input.d == true", or better, "input.d === true".

Regards,
Yihui
